summary: Chart grows the P1 forms the V2 stand-in asked for. Chart.Rule takes `at` (a category, date or number) and draws a vertical event rule labelled at the top of the plot. `isStacked={{ isPercent: true }}` normalises each category to 100% (the axis reads 0–100%; the tooltip and announcer say "60% (120)"; negatives throw). `xScale="linear"` gives a numeric x axis, and Chart.Dots draws markers in a 2px surface ring, with `areaKey`/`areaLabel` for bubbles. New presets ScatterPlot and Histogram (bins from lib/viz, adjacent bars). Scatter hit-testing is nearest-dot within 24px; the baseline is clamped to the plot floor when zero is outside the y domain. Not yet drawn in Paper: recorded in the doc's needsDesign.
